Data:Mackerel.kedgeree.json.Label: Kedgeree
Data:Mackerel.kedgeree.json.Desc: A wonderfully versatile dish favoured for breakfast by the sons of the lark, and for supper by the daughters of the owl.

Data:Mackerel.montecarlo.json.Label: Mackerel Monte Carlo
Data:Mackerel.montecarlo.json.Desc: Most suitable, according to Mrs Arabella Boxer, for a light supper, or a ladies' lunch.

Data:Mackerel.pickled.json.Label: Pickled Mackerel
Data:Mackerel.pickled.json.Desc: Pickling is a kind of afterlife. What comes after afterlife?

Data:Mackerel.poached.json.Label: Poached Mackerel
Data:Mackerel.poached.json.Desc: We do not poach fish in Brancrug without recalling the Turbot Crisis of 1786, when Dr Westcott caught a prodigious turbot, and required the kitchen to poach it for him 'without division'; but no vessel of sufficient size could be found to poach it entire. At last they resorted to 'alchemical assistance'. Mackerel, fortunately, requires no alchemy for its poaching.

Data:Mackerel.soused.json.Label: Soused Mackerel
Data:Mackerel.soused.json.Desc: In Scotland, where the tradition began, soused herrings are more usual, but this far south, on the Marches' edge, we make our own rules.

Data:Maintenance.json.Label: maintenance
Data:Maintenance.json.Desc: A card for wiki maintenance whitch doesn't exist in game

Data:Malachite.aspect.mylissa.json.Label: Aspect of the Malachite: Mylissa, Queen and Palace
Data:Malachite.aspect.mylissa.json.Desc: One of the kinder aspects of the Malachite: Mylissa, both Queen and Palace, who feeds all comers, whose body is the house in which her children dwell. Mylissa was not always a Name of the Malachite. She may have been a Name of another Hour - she may even have begun among the Carapace Cross, before she chose Eternity over History.

Data:Malady.cure.forge.json.label: Cured with Forge
Data:Malady.cure.forge.json.desc: This malady can be cured with bed rest, something bracing to drink, and this much Forge aspect to lift the bosky vapours from the soul.

Data:Malady.cure.grail.json.label: Cured with Grail
Data:Malady.cure.grail.json.desc: This malady can be cured with bed rest, something suitably tempting to drink, and this much Grail aspect to recall the realities of flesh.

Data:Malady.cure.heart.json.label: Cured with Heart
Data:Malady.cure.heart.json.desc: This malady can be cured with bed rest, something restorative to drink, and this much Heart aspect to renew the ailing flesh.

Data:Malady.cure.lantern.json.label: Cured with Lantern
Data:Malady.cure.lantern.json.desc: This malady can be cured with bed rest, something suitable (perhaps bright and invigorating) to drink, and this much Lantern aspect to rekindle the soul's light.

Data:Malady.cure.moth.json.label: Cured with Moth
Data:Malady.cure.moth.json.desc: This malady can be cured with bed rest, something suitable to drink, and this much Moth aspect to distract the possessing presence.

Data:Malady.cure.nectar.json.label: Cured with Nectar
Data:Malady.cure.nectar.json.desc: This malady can be cured with bed rest, something suitable (perhaps green and soothing) to drink, and this much Nectar aspect to bring the frantic soul back to earth.

Data:Malady.cure.sky.json.label: Cured with Sky
Data:Malady.cure.sky.json.desc: This malady can be cured with bed rest, something suitable (perhaps effervescent) to drink, and this much Sky aspect to cheer the haunted soul.

Data:Malady.cure.winter.json.label: Cured with Winter
Data:Malady.cure.winter.json.desc: This malady can be cured with bed rest, something (preferably cold) to drink, and this much Winter aspect to soothe the sensitive soul.

Data:Malady.json.label: Malady
Data:Malady.json.desc: Something has snared or sickened my soul. [Soul cards can be Malady-tainted when you're exposed to dangerous influences - sometimes when you fail in a task. Maladies cannot be exhausted, but your soul is altered and weakened, and there can be serious consequences if they go untreated.]

Data:Maladyrisk.chor.heart.json.label: Malady: Duendracy
Data:Maladyrisk.chor.heart.json.startdescription: My chor has been compromised - by a possessing presence from the Mansus behind the world! Quite a pleasant possessing presence - but it makes it hard to concentrate. [A defeat when Heart is present makes chor vulnerable to duendracy.]

Data:Maladyrisk.ereb.nectar.json.label: Malady: Westengryre
Data:Maladyrisk.ereb.nectar.json.startdescription: My ereb has been compromised by the green-sickness, the wasteland-terror, the bosk-haunt that Abbot Thomas named westengryre, long ago. [A defeat when Nectar is present makes ereb vulnerable to westengryre.]

Data:Maladyrisk.fet.rose.json.label: Malady: Gisting
Data:Maladyrisk.fet.rose.json.startdescription: My fet is gisting - too loosely tethered to me - so that I glimpse the Mansus even in daylight hours. [A defeat when additional Rose is present makes fet vulnerable to gisting.]

Data:Maladyrisk.health.winter.json.label: Malady: Sickness
Data:Maladyrisk.health.winter.json.startdescription: Perhaps the damp air is affecting my lungs. [A defeat when Winter is present risks sickness.]

Data:Maladyrisk.phost.lantern.json.label: Malady: Fascination
Data:Maladyrisk.phost.lantern.json.startdescription: Phost is the brightest part of the soul - sometimes it can grow too bright for safety. [A defeat when additional Lantern is present makes phost vulnerable to fascination.]

Data:Maladyrisk.shapt.knock.json.label: Malady: Acusis
Data:Maladyrisk.shapt.knock.json.startdescription: Acusis is a malady of the soul in which the door, shapt, cannot be closed. [A defeat when additional Knock is present makes shapt vulnerable to acusis.]

Data:Maladyrisk.trist.edge.json.label: Malady: Despair
Data:Maladyrisk.trist.edge.json.startdescription: Trist is already half a hand trailed in a river of deeper sadness. [A defeat when Edge is present can submerge trist in despair.]

Data:Maladyrisk.wist.scale.json.label: Malady: Shell-Crossed
Data:Maladyrisk.wist.scale.json.startdescription: Memory crossed, hatched, lined, snapped. [A defeat when Scale is present can leave wist shell-crossed.]
